story.summaryEn:
Charles 🗣️ "We had a good pace and made the right calls today, with a different strategy that worked out well for us today."
Closing the triple header with a podium in Singapore 🇸🇬
detailZh:
查尔斯说：“我们今天节奏很好，做出了正确的决策，采用了不同的策略，这对我们今天来说效果很好。”
在新加坡🇸🇬结束三连赛，以领奖台的成绩收官。
detailEn:
Charles 🗣️ "We had a good pace and made the right calls today, with a different strategy that worked out well for us today."
Closing the triple header with a podium in Singapore 🇸🇬
